name: From academic excellence to social responsibility

content.title: From academic excellence to social responsibility
content.summary: How studying at AKU SONAM EA shaped Joan Bargeshaia's future

content.text: Joan Bargeshia's experience at Aga Khan University can be termed as transforming and rewarding. An experience that shaped not only her academic knowledge, but also her personal growth and resilience. During her time at AKU, she has had unique experiences, faced challenges head-on, and nurtured aspirations that go beyond her academic pursuits.

One of the highlights of her AKU journey has been the fellowship she formed through collaborative learning. The diverse and vibrant community at AKU provided her with a unique platform to interact with people from all backgrounds, fostering an environment where different views merged to produce a rich bouquet of ideas. Engaging in intellectually stimulating discussions, group projects, and extracurricular activities not only expanded her knowledge base but also taught her the value of teamwork in the pursuit of excellence.

Memorable experiences extend beyond the classroom. AKU's commitment to holistic development is evident in its extracurricular activities and events. Participating in cultural festivals, sports competitions, and community service projects helped her extend her horizons and create a well-rounded personality. These encounters were not only enjoyable, but also helped her develop her interpersonal skills and cultural sensitivity.

However, no educational journey is without hurdles. Joan faced rigorous academic demands putting her time management and organizational skills to test. The pressure to succeed in a competitive setting was often overwhelming. Nonetheless, she overcame these problems by adopting a regular study schedule, receiving advice from several faculty members, and relying on the support of her peers. Joan gradually discovered her own resilience, which allowed her to overcome academic challenges with dedication and endurance.

Looking ahead to her convocation on February 17, her future goals have been greatly affected by the knowledge and abilities she gained at AKU. Joan hopes to make a meaningful contribution to her chosen field by applying the theoretical and practical insights she has received over her scholastic journey. The strong emphasis on ethical ideals at AKU instilled in her a sense of social duty, prompting her to participate in community-based projects and activities that solve real-world issues.

Furthermore, Joan hopes to be a positive change agent, using her education to improve the lives of others. Whether through research, lobbying or practical application of her skills, she is dedicated to improving society. AKU's emphasis on critical thinking and an interdisciplinary approach has given her the tools she needs to handle complicated situations creatively and innovatively. Joan believes that her AKU experience has been diverse and has prepared her for the next part of her life. She possesses not only extensive academic knowledge, but also a strong sense of resilience, adaptability and social responsibility.
